inferredMediaTypes.description: Stated by the STAC Catalog Specification 1.1.0, section Media Type for STAC Catalogs: "A STAC Catalog is a JSON file (RFC 8259), and thus should use the application/json as the Media Type (previously known as the MIME Type)." Not observed in an Implementation Profile or on the testbed (measured on 2026-11-11, bblocks-process-profiles-tests-1 3d8c031): the six testbed outputs that return a STAC Catalog (kindgrove.mangrove result, kindgrove.mangrove-workflow stac, kindgrove-steps.mangrove-workflow-steps stac, kindgrove-steps.export-stac stac_catalog, water-bodies.stac stac_catalog, water-bodies.water-bodies stac) declare a JSON object schema with format stac-catalog and no media type.
